title: Coalition to reunite after Sussan Ley brokers deal with David Littleproud to end second split
summary: Deal will see all former Nationals frontbenchers suspended from shadow ministry until March The Coalition is on the brink of a reunion after Sussan Ley brokered a deal with David Littleproud to bring the Liberals and Nationals back together. The opposition leader is expected to announce the deal on Sunday, reforming the Coalition less than three weeks after a rift over Labor’s hate speech laws split the parties for the second time in eight months.
